event.title: The FSFE at ARTICLE 19's DMA Symposium "Digital Markets Act: from Solo Act to Orchestra" in Brussels, Belgium

body.p: The FSFE will participate in the Digital Markets Act Symposium, "Digital Markets Act: From Solo Act to Orchestra", organised by ARTICLE 19. Jithendra Palepu, Project Manager at the FSFE, will present the research paper "Interoperability in the Law, Restriction by the Contract? Reverse Engineering and Contractual Fairness under the Digital Markets Act"

The research examines how contractual restrictions imposed by gatekeepers may affect reverse engineering undertaken to achieve or verify interoperability in the context of the DMA. It also explores whether LLM-assisted reverse engineering could lower technical barriers to interoperability while leaving contractual and legal obstacles unresolved. The symposium brings together researchers, regulators, technologists and policymakers to discuss DMA implementation and enforcement.
